title: ws80211: Use the channel type enum in functions that take a channel type
description:
Since ws80211_utils.h defines a channel type enum, have that enum
be used instead of an int in functions like ws8011_chan_type_to_str
and ws80211_get_center_frequency.

WirelessFrame stores the enum value as a QVariant; pass the enum
back when calculating the center frequency instead of having
WirelessFrame convert the enum to a bandwidth.
